Name: Life Safe Boat Cover Reinforcement and Repair Tape 8-3/4 inch x 10', Gray
Natural: The Life Safe Boat Cover Repair Tape is the ideal way to prolong the life of your boat cover. It adds strength and tear-resistance along seams, stress points, creases and corners to avoid tear and snags. This extra strong tape resists stretching, wrinkling and tearing. Use it as extra padding on stress points around windshields or trolling motors to help your cover last more. This gray Life Safe tape is also great for bimini tops, sails, canvas awnings and pool covers. With the Life Safe boat cover repair tape, you are able to easily repair tears or cuts in your boat cover fabric. It is also great to have at hand in case you need to fix anything in an emergency or at the last minute.
